'''Wakeelmui''' was a world located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the corporation [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] maintained a presence in the [[Wakeelmui system/Legends|Wakeelmui star system]]. It was also the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Imperial [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Barich]] who worked for Sienar Fleet Systems in the missile division.

==Description==
Wakeelmui was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="CCGW" /> located in the [[Wakeelmui system/Legends|eponymous star system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]]<ref name="Region" /> portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. By [[3705 BBY/Legends|3705 BBY]], Wakeelmui was situated between the planets [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] and [[Uviuy Exen/Legends|Uviuy Exen]] on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] known as the [[Corsin Run]]. At some point following [[3694 BBY]], the hyperlane was integrated into the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]].<ref name="EA" /> In addition, two other routes passed through Wakeelmui: the [[Shawken Spur]], leading toward the [[Shawken system/Legends|Shawken system]],<ref name="EA" /><ref name="EGW" /> and another route leading toward the [[Perave system|Arkania system]].<ref name="EGW" />

==History==
===The Old Republic era===
[[File:WakeelmuiEGW.jpg|280px|left|thumb|Wakeelmui on the map throughout the Alsakan Conflicts]]
The cosmic space surrounding Wakeelmui was explored by the nascent [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] at the dawn of its existence, sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="EA" /><ref name="EGW" /> Amid escalating socioeconomic tensions between the planets of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], a [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|series of military clashes]] broke out over leadership of the Republic, Wakeelmui supported the latter, which became the patron of the [[Human/Legends|human]]-dominated sectors along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. This long-lasting rivalry took place on a grand scale, with seventeen separate conflicts spanning 140 [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]. The [[First Alsakan Conflict|first]] began in [[17,000 BBY]], and the [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict|final campaigns]] ended in [[3017 BBY]], when both sides finally signed a [[Alsakan Conflicts peace treaty|peace treaty]].<ref name="EGW" />

===Imperial reign===
[[File:SgtBarich.png|230px|right|thumb|Barich, a native Wakeelmui]]
After the [[Declaration of a New Order|proclamation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Wakeelmui was under the authority of Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Yount]], whose duties included being in charge of a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on the world.<ref name="CCGSW" /> The industry leader in fighter production, the corporation [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], maintained a presence in the [[Wakeelmui system/Legends|Wakeelmui star system]], where it constantly worked on advancements to the baseline [[TIE series/Legends|TIE-series]] design<ref name="CCGSFS">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Sienar Fleet Systems}}</ref> and mass-produced the [[L-s7.2 laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] for multiple TIE models.<ref name="CCGTC">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=SFS L-s7.2 TIE Cannon}}</ref> A native of Wakeelmui, [[Barich]] was an employee of the corporation's missile division before entering the Imperial military.<ref name="CCGSB">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Sergeant Barich}}</ref><ref name="CEBS">{{CSWECite|I|61|Barich, Sergeant}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Wakeelmui was introduced in ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'', an expansion of [[Decipher]]'s ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' released in [[1998]].<ref name="Decipher">{{Decipher|url=starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html|text=The Expansions}}</ref> Later, the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], placed the Wakeelmui system, and therefore the world itself, in grid square L-9.<ref name="EA" />
